name: Editorial
pitch: A story-led talk told like a long-read magazine feature, with drop caps, pull quotes, and figures.

illustration.medium: flat vector, literary-magazine spot illustration on warm cream paper
illustration.shapes: simple editorial motifs: a drop cap, a rule, a single figure or object, generous margins
illustration.texture: faint paper texture, no digital gloss
illustration.palette_use: warm cream background dominant, near-black ink, one brick-red accent used for a single editorial mark (rule, initial, or figure)
illustration.avoid: gradients, neon color, digital UI chrome, hand-drawn wobble, clutter
